inputs.description: The root folder of a BIDS valid dataset (sub-XXXXX folders should be found at the top level in this folder).
inputs.name: bids_dir

inputs.description: The output path for the outcomes of preprocessing and visual reports
inputs.name: output_dir

inputs.description: Processing stage to be run, only "participant" in the case of PETPrep (see BIDS-Apps specification).
inputs.name: analysis_level

inputs.description: Assume the input dataset is BIDS compliant and skip the validation
inputs.name: skip_bids_validation

inputs.description: A space delimited list of participant identifiers or a single identifier (the sub- prefix can be removed)
inputs.name: participant_label

inputs.description: A space delimited list of session identifiers or a single identifier (the ses- prefix can be removed)
inputs.name: session_label

inputs.description: A space delimited list of tracer identifiers or a single identifier (the trc- prefix can be removed)
inputs.name: tracer_label

inputs.description: A space delimited list of reconstruction identifiers or a single identifier (the rec- prefix can be removed)
inputs.name: rec_label

inputs.description: A space delimited list of run identifiers or a single identifier (the run- prefix can be removed)
inputs.name: run_label

inputs.description: Concatenate PET runs within each session before preprocessing. Combined files omit the run entity.
inputs.name: combine_runs

inputs.description: Method to produce the reference anatomical space: "first-lex" uses the first T1w image in lexicographical order; "unbiased" constructs an unbiased template from all T1w images (previously "--longitudinal"); "sessionwise" independently processes each session, with multiple runs within a session handled similarly to "first-lex". (Default: "first-lex")
inputs.name: subject_anatomical_reference

inputs.description: Select a specific task to be processed
inputs.name: task_id

inputs.description: A JSON file describing custom BIDS input filters using PyBIDS. For further details, please check out https://petprep.readthedocs.io/en/latest/faq.html#how-do-I-select-only-certain-files-to-be-input-to-PETPrep
inputs.name: bids_filter_file

inputs.description: Search PATH(s) for pre-computed derivatives. These may be provided as named folders (e.g., `--derivatives smriprep=/path/to/smriprep`).
inputs.name: derivatives

inputs.description: Path to a PyBIDS database folder, for faster indexing (especially useful for large datasets). Will be created if not present.
inputs.name: bids_database_dir

inputs.description: Maximum number of threads across all processes
inputs.name: nprocs

inputs.description: Maximum number of threads per-process
inputs.name: omp_nthreads

inputs.description: Upper bound memory limit for PETPrep processes
inputs.name: mem

inputs.description: Attempt to reduce memory usage (will increase disk usage in working directory)
inputs.name: low_mem

inputs.description: Nipype plugin configuration file
inputs.name: use_plugin

inputs.description: Use low-quality tools for speed - TESTING ONLY
inputs.name: sloppy

inputs.description: Run anatomical workflows only
inputs.name: anat_only

inputs.description: Processing level; may be 'minimal' (nothing that can be recomputed), 'resampling' (recomputable targets that aid in resampling) or 'full' (all target outputs). (Default: "full")
inputs.name: level

inputs.description: Generate boilerplate only
inputs.name: boilerplate_only

inputs.description: Only generate reports, don't run workflows. This will only rerun report aggregation, not reportlet generation for specific nodes.
inputs.name: reports_only

inputs.description: Ignore selected aspects of the input dataset to disable corresponding parts of the workflow (a space delimited list)
inputs.name: ignore

inputs.description: Standard and non-standard spaces to resample anatomical and PET images to. Standard spaces may be specified by the form ``<SPACE>[:cohort-<label>][:res-<resolution>][...]``, where ``<SPACE>`` is a keyword designating a spatial reference, and may be followed by optional, colon-separated parameters. Non-standard spaces imply specific orientations and sampling grids. Important to note, the ``res-*`` modifier does not define the resolution used for the spatial normalization. To generate no PET outputs, use this option without specifying any spatial references. For further details, please check out https://petprep.readthedocs.io/en/latest/spaces.html
inputs.name: output_spaces

inputs.description: Deprecated - use `--subject-anatomical-reference unbiased` instead
inputs.name: longitudinal

inputs.description: Degrees of freedom when registering PET to anatomical images. 6 degrees (rotation and translation) are used by default. (Default: "6")
inputs.name: pet2anat_dof

inputs.description: Method for PET-to-anatomical registration. "auto" runs both FreeSurfer and ANTs and selects the best. "mri_coreg" uses FreeSurfer mri_coreg. "robust" uses FreeSurfer mri_robust_register (6 DoF only). "ants" uses ANTs rigid registration (6 DoF only). "identity" trusts the PET and anatomical image headers and performs no registration optimization. (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: pet2anat_method

inputs.description: Disable robust FOV cropping of the anatomical reference before PET-to-T1w registration. This also disables the auto-mode uncropped anatomical fallback.
inputs.name: pet2anat_no_anat_crop

inputs.description: Anatomical reference to use for PET-to-T1w registration. The default ('auto') inspects the PET-derived mask and uses the preprocessed T1-weighted image unless the mask is unusually large, in which case it switches to FreeSurfer's bias-corrected nu.mgz. Use 't1w' to always keep the preprocessed T1w image, or 'nu' to always prefer FreeSurfer's bias-corrected volume (an intensity normalized volume generated after correcting for non-uniformity in the orig.mgz). (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: anatref

inputs.description: Deprecated - use `--force bbr` instead.
inputs.name: force_bbr

inputs.description: Deprecated - use `--force no-bbr` instead.
inputs.name: force_no_bbr

inputs.description: Initialize the random seed for the workflow
inputs.name: random_seed

inputs.description: Organization of outputs. "bids" (default) places PETPrep derivatives directly in the output directory, and defaults to placing FreeSurfer derivatives in <output-dir>/sourcedata/freesurfer. "legacy" creates derivative datasets as subdirectories of outputs. (Default: "bids")
inputs.name: output_layout

inputs.description: Maximum number of sessions aggregated in one subject's visual report. If exceeded, visual reports are split by session. (Default: 4)
inputs.name: aggregate_session_reports

inputs.description: Replace medial wall values with NaNs on PET GIFTI files. Only performed for GIFTI files mapped to a freesurfer subject (fsaverage or fsnative).
inputs.name: medial_surface_nan

inputs.description: Exclude voxels whose timeseries have locally high coefficient of variation from surface resampling. Only performed for GIFTI files mapped to a freesurfer subject (fsaverage or fsnative).
inputs.name: project_goodvoxels

inputs.description: Skip generation of HTML and LaTeX formatted citation with pandoc
inputs.name: md_only_boilerplate

inputs.description: Output preprocessed PET as a CIFTI dense timeseries. Optionally, the number of grayordinate can be specified (default is 91k, which equates to 2mm resolution) (Default: false)
inputs.name: cifti_output

inputs.description: Disable Multimodal Surface Matching surface registration.
inputs.name: no_msm

inputs.description: Include all components estimated in CompCor decomposition in the confounds file instead of only the components sufficient to explain 50 percent of PET variance in each CompCor mask
inputs.name: return_all_components

inputs.description: Threshold for flagging a frame as an outlier on the basis of framewise displacement (Default: 0.5)
inputs.name: fd_spike_threshold

inputs.description: Threshold for flagging a frame as an outlier on the basis of standardised DVARS (Default: 1.5)
inputs.name: dvars_spike_threshold

inputs.description: Select a template for skull-stripping with antsBrainExtraction (OASIS30ANTs, by default) (Default: "OASIS30ANTs")
inputs.name: skull_strip_template

inputs.description: Do not use a random seed for skull-stripping - will ensure run-to-run replicability when used with --omp-nthreads 1 and matching --random-seed <int>
inputs.name: skull_strip_fixed_seed

inputs.description: Perform T1-weighted skull stripping ('force' ensures skull stripping, 'skip' ignores skull stripping, and 'auto' applies brain extraction based on the outcome of a heuristic to check whether the brain is already masked). (Default: "force")
inputs.name: skull_strip_t1w

inputs.description: Path to FreeSurfer license key file. Get it (for free) by registering at https://surfer.nmr.mgh.harvard.edu/registration.html
inputs.name: fs_license_file

inputs.description: Enable FreeSurfer sub-millimeter (hires) reconstruction.
inputs.name: submm_recon

inputs.description: EXPERT: Import pre-computed FreeSurfer reconstruction without resuming. The user is responsible for ensuring that all necessary files are present.
inputs.name: fs_no_resume

inputs.description: FWHM for Gaussian smoothing applied during head-motion estimation. (Default: 10)
inputs.name: hmc_fwhm

inputs.description: Time (in seconds) after which head-motion estimation is performed. (Default: 120)
inputs.name: hmc_start_time

inputs.description: Initial frame index for head-motion estimation; omit or use 'auto' to select the frame with highest uptake. (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: hmc_init_frame

inputs.description: Keep the chosen initial reference frame fixed during head-motion estimation.
inputs.name: hmc_init_frame_fix

inputs.description: Policy for automatic HMC memory safeguards. 'auto' estimates robust-template memory from the PET data and enables fixed-frame/subsample safeguards for high-risk scans; 'off' disables these automatic safeguards. (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: hmc_memory_policy

inputs.description: Disable head-motion correction and use the uncorrected data.
inputs.name: hmc_off

inputs.description: Strategy for generating the PET reference. 'auto' (default) evaluates multiple strategies to select the best reference. 'template' uses the motion correction template, while 'twa' computes a time-weighted average, 'sum' produces a summed image of the motion-corrected series, and 'first5min' averages the early (0-5 minute) portion of the acquisition. (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: petref

inputs.description: Segmentation method to use. (Default: "gtm")
inputs.name: seg

inputs.description: Predefined reference regions. Pair with --ref-mask-index to define custom labels.
inputs.name: ref_mask_name

inputs.description: List of segmentation indices to use for the reference mask.
inputs.name: ref_mask_index

inputs.description: Tool to use for partial volume correction
inputs.name: pvc_tool

inputs.description: PVC method identifier. PETPVC: GTM, IY, IY+RL, IY+VC, LABBE, LABBE+MTC, LABBE+MTC+RL, LABBE+MTC+VC, LABBE+RBV, LABBE+RBV+RL, LABBE+RBV+VC, MG, MG+RL, MG+VC, MTC, MTC+RL, MTC+VC, RBV, RBV+RL, RBV+VC, RL, STC, VC. PETSurfer: AGTM, GTM, MG, RBV.
inputs.name: pvc_method

inputs.description: Point spread function FWHM (one value or three values)
inputs.name: pvc_psf

inputs.description: Tracks power draws using CodeCarbon package
inputs.name: track_carbon

inputs.description: Country ISO code used by carbon trackers (Default: "CAN")
inputs.name: country_code

inputs.description: Increases log verbosity for each occurrence. Debug level is '-vvv'.
inputs.name: verbose

inputs.description: Path where intermediate results should be stored
inputs.name: work_dir

inputs.description: Clears working directory of contents. Use of this flag is not recommended when running concurrent processes of PETPrep.
inputs.name: clean_workdir

inputs.description: Enable Nipype's resource monitoring to keep track of memory and CPU usage
inputs.name: resource_monitor

inputs.description: Use pre-generated configuration file. Values in file will be overridden by command-line arguments.
inputs.name: config_file

inputs.description: Write workflow graph.
inputs.name: write_graph

inputs.description: Force stopping on first crash, even if a work directory was specified.
inputs.name: stop_on_first_crash

inputs.description: Opt-out of sending tracking information of this run to the PETPrep developers. This information helps to improve PETPrep and provides an indicator of real world usage crucial for obtaining funding.
inputs.name: notrack

inputs.description: Debug mode(s) to enable. 'all' is alias for all available modes.
inputs.name: debug
